item.title: Overview of Awesome LLM Causal Reasoning Works and Methods
item.description:
Overview of Awesome LLM Causal Reasoning Works and Methods

Awesome LLM Causal Reasoning is a collection of LLM-based causal reasoning works, including papers, codes, and datasets, providing a comprehensive review of research aimed at enhancing Large Language Models for causal reasoning (CR).

🧩 How it works

  • Existing methods are categorized based on the role of LLMs: either as reasoning engines or as helpers providing knowledge or data to traditional CR methods.
  • End tasks are categorized into three groups: causal discovery, causal inference, and additional causal tasks.
  • Performance of LLMs is evaluated on various causal reasoning tasks using pass@1 accuracy with strategies such as zero-shot.

⚙️ Key details

The collection includes various notable works and papers:

💡 Why it matters

  • The review provides key findings and in-depth analysis of LLM performance on causal reasoning tasks.
  • It offers insights from current studies and highlights promising directions for future research.
